svg.title: Make Privacy, Scope, and Acceptance Observable
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-privacy-scope-acceptance-roadmap; chapter number: 12; title: Make Privacy, Scope, and Acceptance Observable; subtitle: Organize boundary checks before treating the work as ready for acceptance.; caption: Augusto Digital defines the shipped outcome; ProtaSystem bounds changes and liability; Protecto and Cognitive Capital separate privacy checks; Bryan Taylor exposes usage costs; neomanex verifies observable requirements.; assumptions note: The weekly sequence is a planning arrangement, not a practitioner-reported four-week delivery promise. Augusto Digital reports a six-week launch. SecureCyberGates's 35-day deletion review is a contract-dependent example, not a Week 4 deadline.; note: Augusto Digital — VzBpfD_Dcq8 at 00:07:01 and 00:08:05; ProtaSystem — 6l0a6If9Oyk at 00:02:38 and 00:03:49; Protecto — e8kcLoVVX_A at 00:01:54; Cognitive Capital — j2Bqq0VTv0o at 00:03:38; Bryan Taylor — yLxvwa45vR8 at 00:03:04 and 00:03:17; neomanex — wOkT9r5iVME at 00:02:25, 00:06:42, and 00:07:01; SecureCyberGates — TcAbiyEqBFM at 00:04:39.; chart type: timeline_roadmap; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Freeze the outcome and commercial boundary; deliverable: Use Augusto Digital's outcome, owner, and date. Define each requirement by who acts, what they can do, and externally observable proof, as neomanex describes. Include ProtaSystem's priced change-order pause and aggregate liability cap tied to the amount actually paid.; gate: Is the shipped outcome explicit, with extra work separated from the original commitment?; week: Week 2; title: Check sensitive information handling; deliverable: Apply Protecto's separate checks for training, retention eligibility, exceptions, abuse monitoring, storage location, inference location, and necessary sensitive fields. Follow Cognitive Capital's redaction checks for documents, prompts, responses, and observability records.; gate: Have privacy settings been checked separately and redaction tested against actual business information rather than assumed from a no-training promise?; week: Week 3; title: Expose consumption and price additions; deliverable: Provide consumption reporting and an admin tool as Bryan Taylor recommends. Keep Augusto Digital's deferred ideas outside the current build, with requester names attached. Apply ProtaSystem's pause before unpriced additions.; gate: Can the owner inspect usage, and does boundary crossing trigger a documented, priced change?; week: Week 4; title: Inspect acceptance and deletion commitments; deliverable: Use neomanex's observable acceptance checks, including promised screens and states. Define backup and snapshot deletion verification and ticket review according to the project contract, following SecureCyberGates.; gate: Can each promised behavior be observed, are remaining owner decisions explicit, and is deletion verification scheduled? neomanex reported 36 of 36 requirements passing in round five, yet a later done-when review still found four gaps.
